question: To what extent do existing subgraph-aware language model training methods (e.g., subgraph-aware contrastive learning) overlap with our proposed local context subgraph enrichment?
description: Assess similarity between our context subgraph idea and existing methods that incorporate subgraph structure into LM training for KG completion or QA.
rationale: High overlap would reduce novelty; low overlap would support a distinct contribution.
resolution: No evidence found in the six most relevant retrieved papers that existing subgraph-aware language model training methods overlap with the proposed local context subgraph enrichment; one paper (arxiv:2212.00959) uses contrastive pre-training for question-relation matching, which is not equivalent to enriching triples with local context subgraphs from source passages.
